title: Display message type in `Console` output
body:
### Confirmation

- [x] I confirm that I am a maintainer and so can use this template. If I am not, I understand this issue will be closed and I will be asked to use a different template.

### Issue body

Make the `Console` also print out the type of messages. For example,

```
--------- TextMessage (user) -----------
xxx
--------- ToolCallRequestEvent (assistant) --------
xxxx
--------- ToolCallExecutionEvent (assistant) --------
xxxx
--------- TextMessage (assistant) ---------
xxxx
```

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue involves memory-related symptoms, specifically the representation and display of message types in the agent system's console output, which aligns with the "Memory content errors" sub-category.
